_comment: Planned part changes, keyed by the STOCK footprint library id. area_mm2 is the replacement's area PER PLACEMENT (0 = delete the part). height_mm feeds the Z estimate. Everything here is a hypothesis until you have a real part number and have checked it against the rules - the 'why' column is what a reviewer reads, so fill it in.

pcbgolf:LQFP-144_20x20mm_P0.5mm.why: STM32H725 UFBGA169 10x10 (or AG 7x7). CAN/SDIO must land on capable pins; firmware change is allowed. WARNING: 0.5mm BGA escape may force a 6th layer, which costs more than the area saves.

pcbgolf:0805-C.why: 0603 bulk caps; check ripple current and derating.

pcbgolf:SOIC-8_3.9x4.9mm_P1.27mm.why: U9-U12 are OPA197 used open-loop as comparators driving the CAN activity LEDs (CAN_H vs CAN_L, +5V/100k offset sets the threshold). Not current sense -- IMON goes straight from TPS25944 pin 19 to the MCU. CAN_RX already reaches the MCU, so firmware can drive LED2-LED5 instead: delete 4 op-amps + R50-R61 (182mm2 total), keep R62-R65 as LED limits. Firmware changes are explicitly allowed. Needs 4 spare GPIOs.

pcbgolf:USB-C-FEMALE-VERT-GCT.why: Horizontal SMT USB-C instead of vertical: same mating plug, 10.1mm -> 3.2mm. ASK COMMA whether this satisfies 'mechanically compatible'.

pcbgolf:QFN64-9X9.why: USB2514B QFN36 6x6 if 4 downstream ports are enough. Count the hub's ports in the schematic first.

pcbgolf:M2_BOLT.why: Mounting holes are not in the README feature list. ASK COMMA before relying on this.

pcbgolf:EVQ-Q2.why: Smaller SMD tact switch; must still be pressable by a finger.

pcbgolf:SOT23-5.why: SOT-523 / SC-74A where the part exists at the same ratings.

pcbgolf:0472192001.why: Smaller microSD socket. Hard floor is the card itself, 15x11mm.

pcbgolf:DCJACK_2MM_SMT.why: Low-profile 2.1mm barrel jack. Mating-locked by rule, so the barrel OD sets the floor at ~7mm. This part sets Z.
